import.disclaimer: You can save your original DinoRPG account on EternalDinoRPG.&& &&All your dinoz, items and ingredients will be saved. The same applies to the status, skills, levels and appearances of your dinoz.&& &&Missions carried out by your dinoz will not be saved, some will be automatically completed due to their mandatory nature.&&The same applies to items equipped on your dinoz. To start saving, save the cookie link as a new bookmark, go to the dinorRPG site and click on the new bookmark. Then paste the cookie in the appropriate field, and click on the button of the server you wish to import.&&&Accept the use of the twinoid application when prompted.&& &&The more dinos you have in your account, the longer it will take to save. **Do not leave the page while importing.**&& &&You can restart the import a second time. Only one server can be saved. You won't be able to save the progress and dinoz of all servers at once, so choose carefully!&& &&If you have any questions or problems, don't hesitate to contact us on the Eternaltwin Discord.

description.port: Created by monks many years ago, Frish Port has flourished in recent years thanks to increased trade with the Atlanteid Islands. Unfortunately for you, the fish are so plentiful and easy to catch that there are no boats to take you to the nearby islands. The only ways to reach them are by learning to swim or finding a buoy.
description.market: A large open-air market where everything and anything is bought and sold. Merchants come from all corners of Dinoland to trade their goods here, so from time to time you may find a bargain! Beware, it's also the hideout of unscrupulous people who will attempt to swindle you for your gold coins.
description.papy: Grandpa Joe is an old, retired warrior, but in his younger days he travelled all over Dinoland. These days he tells his stories to any Dinoz Master willing to listen to him. Those who sit and listen to his stories are often offered missions in return.
description.forcebrut: The BrutForce Tournament is one of the most popular competitions among Dinoz tamers. Here, the most powerful Dinoz compete with each other in spectacular battles for the entertainment of the public. Thankfully, the Tournament isn't only reserved for the elite, rookie tamers can also compete here to train their Dinoz.
description.dnv: Welcome to Dinotown! This town was created by the Dinoz tamers a long time ago. After many centuries of existence, it is now the capital of Dinoland and the ideal training ground for young Dinoz masters. Don't hesitate to visit the surrounding areas before adventuring in wilder lands.
description.universite: The University of Dinotown is full of bearded professors and stern-looking, students. Although you can't understand what they're talking about, the fate of the world depends on their research - or so they say. One professor, however, is very friendly; he offers to meet with you from time to time to teach you some important lessons.
description.fountj: The Fountain of Youth has two uses. By day, it's a quiet place where Dinoz Masters, exhausted after their travels, can rest peacefully. By night, it's a haunt where love-lorn residents can let slip a few tears or a forlorn sigh. Some say that the fountain's salty waters are the pained tears of heartbroken lovers.
description.colesc: The Precipitous Hills - a mountain range in it's own right. However, they are so close to the nearby "Big All-Hot" volcano, they seem tiny. Their slopes are still impossible to climb without the appropriate climbing gear.
description.skull: In a remote corner of the Kingdom of Dinoville sits the Lost Cemetery of Twilight. It's an extremely mysteriously place that is the center of many rumors: ghosts, strange apparitions or disappearances, deformed monsters or magic beings... over time these phenomenons have increased so that some have wondered if the cemetery could be connected to another world...
description.auree: After this point, stretches the deepest, most mysterious, and above all most dangerous forest in all of Dinoland. The greatest adventurers have died here, so be prepared before your Dinoz enters.
description.chemin: Through this immense Forest, you can see a path. It's certainly the path that is used by Dinoz tamers to go through the forest. In any case, its better to not stray from the path as the risk of getting lost or being devoured by a Korgon is very high.
description.collin: These hills rise from the west side of the forest. They are covered by large dark trees which sometimes seem alive. Many believe that the hills move during the night when nobody is looking. What mystery are these strange hills hiding?
description.fleuve: Jumin River is the largest water feature in Dinoland. It flows through the large Grumhel Forest. Due to its width and the strength of its flow, it's impossible to cross it without advanced swimming equipment. A simple buoy won't be enough...
description.camp: This part of the Forest has been decimated by small creatures called Korgons. They are very bad-tempered and spend their time harassing the various creatures of the Forest. Luckily, this group of Korgons seems to have devoured enough wood, and are not interested in your calfs.
description.jungle: Long ago, in this part of the forest which more ressembles a Jungle, lived strange creatures. According to folklore, they looked like Ninja-Monkeys. But these creatures haven't been seen for years, to the point that most people doubt that they ever existed.
description.garde: This part of the Jungle is one of the most isolated parts of Dinoland. A few Dinoz masters have adventured here, but even fewer have returned alive. The vegetation is so dense here that it forms a veritable wall which stretches for many kilometers! The only opening is a small portal at the edge of the Blacksylva forest, but it is protected by a strange creature known as «Forest Warden».
description.chutes: The Mutant Falls are certainly one of the greatest myths of Dinoland. Indeed, the ocean water rushes all day long in this huge hole without its level dropping. Great scientists have imagined that there is a place far away where water returns to the ocean, but no one has ever believed them.
description.baobob: Bao Bob is a strange character. He claims to be one of the representatives of an ancient population of giants that disappeared from the surface of Dinoland hundreds of years ago. His eye has seen more secrets of Dinoland than any living resident. The stories he tells are extraordinary and entertain the children a lot.
description.dome: A town under the sea! The Underwater Dome shelters the last survivors of the Atlantis civilization. In the past, they have dominated the Atlanteid Islands but a strange illness has all but exterminated them. The Dome is still magnificent despite it being centuries old.
description.marais_flood: Ce marais qui occupe le milieu de l'archipel est un véritable problème pour les voyageurs ! Suivant les jours, il change d'état. On dit qu'il existe depuis plusieurs millénaires, et certains pensent même qu'il s'agit d'un gigantesque être vivant doué d'un très mauvais sens de l'humour. Today, the swamp is completely flooded ! You can't move! You will have to wait until tomorrow to get out of this quagmire.
description.marais_fog: This swamp in the middle of the archipelago is a real problem for travelers! Depending on the days, it changes its state. People say it has been like this for thousands of years. Some even think that it's a giant living creature with a terrible sense of humour. Aujourd'hui, le marais est perdu dans la brume... Vous n'y trouverez surement aucun monstre à combattre.
description.marais: This swamp in the middle of the archipelago is a real problem for travelers! Depending on the days, it changes its state. People say it has been like this for thousands of years. Some even think that it's a giant living creature with a terrible sense of humour. Aujourd'hui, les eaux sont basses : vous pouvez vous déplacer normalement.
description.corail: Large quantities of Coral have recently surfaced after having been submerged underwater for years. Coral is extremely popular in Dinoland due to its extraordinary strength. The mines employ hundreds of people.
description.ilewkk: Waïkiki is a small island which forms part of the Atlanteid archipelago. It stands out for its purple palm trees, whose long leaves are used to give bright colors to many clothes on Dinoland. Local humans also practice a very famous Martial Art, Waïkikidô.
description.chbroc: On the top of a rock on the Atlanteid Islands sits a workshop. Some say that the inventor who chose to live there did so to escape the mockery of the other citizens, but it seems to have a more specific purpose...
description.dplaza: This new area is difficult to get to, but many residents migrate here in order to flee the congestion of the capital. You can find everything there, and it has recently become a very fashionable place, where new attractions such as the Dinoz Competition are springing up.
description.villa: A villa apparently, which looks more like a holiday cottage on wheels, seemingly abandoned on the beach, bears the sign: "Warning, Disgruntled Dinoz". Maybe it's best to find another route...?
description.dcine: At the foothills of the Small Canyon, one of the Pre-dinozian caves has been converted into a magnificent Cinema. The latest films are shown here and budding filmmakers can even come here to learn how to make their own films.
description.clinik: This is the location of the newly built Dinotown Clinic, the treatment here is said to be the best in all of Dinoland.
description.chato: Once through the massive doorway, the throne room lies straight ahead of you. You see a few guards here and there, some talking about the latest fashionable game, others drying their clothes on racks, the atmosphere... relaxed. The king, always in a good mood, awaits you in the throne room.
description.poste: This guard post allows the soldiers of the castle to regulate the entrances and exits around the royal domain. This place offers a nice view of the King's castle. The post is very well guarded, and it is better not to bother the soldiers, one says that their captain is ruthless!
description.portal: The pentacle drawn on the ground projects a bright light which dissipates the clouds of Nimbao. Unfortunately, the beam is not powerful enough to transport you to the skies. You will have to manage on your own.
description.bslt: The Basalt Slopes are located on the sides of the Big All-Hot. These are large expanses formed of tangled volcanic rocks. A path takes shape there, winding up to the summit. Ambushes are easy and frequent here, so be careful to defend yourself well when taking this path.
description.forges: The Forges work near the top of the Big All-Hot using magma from the volcano in order to create their wares. The magma flows slowly down the side of the main streets, supplying the smiths who are working day and night crafting metallic wares, the best in Dinoland.
description.rashpk: Ashpouk is an ancient civilization located on the top of the Big All-Hot. Unfortunately a volcanic eruption has destroyed their city, and only deserted ruins remain. The locals are very superstitious and never approach the ruins, fearing the curses which are said to exist there.
description.fosslv: The Lavapit is located on top of the Big All-Hot. The view from the Lavapit is magnificent as you see the whole of Dinotown, the Atlanteid Islands, the Great Forest of Grumhel and even the white peaks of Caushemesh when the weather is particularly pleasant. In the center of the plateau stands a Shaman Temple, which has to rebuilt each time an earthquake occurs, which, seeing as its located on the top of a volcano, is a regular occurence.
description.vener: The Venerable's Lair is the most dangerous place in the Big All-Hot. In a hidden cave lives a very old Flamethrowing Dragon, who is not only bad-tempered but also hates being disturbed. Interestingly, people say that he likes little Korgons... well-grilled, seasoned with a touch of salt.
description.tunel: Near the Lavapit stands a very old tree. Its bark is so dense that even lava flows have not damaged it, which has helped it to survive many volcanic eruptions. Recently, a lava flow has cleared the entrance of a Tunnel at the bottom of the tree. This tunnel seems to burrow deep into the Big All-Hot. In order to explore it, you will need a Lantern to guide you.
description.gorges: The Deep Gorges are a narrow rock passage on the side of the Big All-Hot. After a succession of flooded valleys, the gorges open up into an immense Forest. You can see the Jumin River flowing to the south. Without doubt you can now access the Northern part of Grumhel Forest!
description.tourbt: A ginormous tower stands tall on the Great Heat. It pierces the clouds, hiding the summit from your view. The journey to the top will be long but the view is worth the detour.
description.senter: The path that crosses the Blacksylva Door leads directly to an immense steppe of burning sand stretching as far as the eye can see... Some electric arcs menacingly roar in the sky. The sand is the result of Lodestone friction, the rock which can be found in huge quantity in this region...
description.scross: The deep path that lies here, has been maintained for generations by the Rocky slaves transporting Lodestone between the Citadel in the north and Grumhel Forest. This road is now too dangerous to travel on alone. Another, safer route has been found beyond the "Sabot", to the east
description.svillg: The Outpost is a relay point for the merchants coming from Grumhel. Much safer than Nomad's Junction, this stop is the last peaceful haven before the dangers that await you in the Magnetic Steppes.
description.sking: At the center of the steppes stands a large, mysterious rock. The Citadel of the Rocky King is located inside. For generations, the royal family - half-human half-mineral - have controlled the Rockies and they exercise their autority throughout the Magnetic Steppes.
description.spylon: Located in the middle of the desert are the Pylons, a natural formation of Lodestone that continually creates the mighty electric arcs! It's better to not stay here too long, as you may be electrocuted by the Pylons.
description.slake: The quicksand here is extremely dangerous: full of Lodestone, it appears just like water. Many thirsty adventurers have fallen for this intricate trap and have been swallowed alive. People say that for each victim, the Syphon emits a melodic whistle, hence it's haunting name.
description.scanyo: Between the highlands of Toulaho lie the Trails of Toutemba, known for the many dinoz that have disappeared in the landslides of Magnetite. The ground is covered by jagged and burning stones, and the lodestone rock faces regularly generate deadly electric arcs in the middle of the road.
description.stowr1: Dinoz Masters have fought for eternity to take control of the Devourer's daily seed production. There are three Devourers in the Magnetic Steppes, but people say that they all have the same origin. Only a Great Lord will be able to capture and control the three Devourers!
description.stowr2: Dinoz Masters have fought for eternity to take control of the Devourer's daily seed production. People say that whoever gathers 100 seeds will see his wish granted. In the meantime, the seeds are resold for a very good price to the Traveling Merchant.
description.stowr3: Dinoz Masters have fought for eternity to take control of the Devourer's daily seed production. According to the legend of the Nomads, Devourers feed on the blood shed by their victims.
description.sband1: The Zaxa have always been pillagers and are highly logical, renowned for their flawless skill and errorless work. Their convoy attacks are even recognized by local tourist guides…
description.sband2: The Emmemma are pitiless mercenaries well known for their ancient ambush tactics. First, they send massive boulders into the ravine, then attack with clubs until their foes have been beaten an inch within their lives. Then they scavange. Only then do we pick up. No arguing no hassling.
description.sband3: The Mattmut are the specialists of filtering and piped-up games. Less aggressive than their neighbours, they are no less dangerous, provided you hold your gold. Their technique consists of exhausting the opponent with their traditional songs.
description.scampw: The hidden lair of the W-Team… They take refuge there in times of great danger, in order to heal their wounds and prepare their counter-attack! These nomads have a will of steel and never admit defeat. Many of their enemies have perished for having slackened their attention, believing to have struck them down for good…
description.scaush: On the fringes of the Steppes stands an impassable rocky barrier... you can see a chain of mountains in the distance, the homeland of the Santaz: the Caushemesh Mountains. Who knows what dangers and what adventures await you there, if you ever manage to get there...
description.sport: Hidden most of the time by sandstorms, an imposing gate stands in the wilderness of the steppes, at the foot of the Caushemesh Mountains. As the only point of entry into this mysterious kingdom, it prevents anyone from entering it - or would it rather be from leaving it?
description.iroche: You are on a peninsula at one end of the celestial island of Nimbao, where large rocks protrude from the ground. Some people call these the dragon's horns. Very few people come here, probably because there is nothing to do except contemplate the void...
description.ipont: The only way to cross this precipice is to cross the bridge. A violent wind is blowing, best watch your step. Due to this being the only point of entry to the rest of the island, the bridge is often guarded by Grizorg's soldiers.
description.iporte: A stone plaque states that only those who are chosen may pass through this gate.
description.icite: The city of Arboris is dug into the rock. These peaceful people live in harmony here, and each generation must contribute to the community, even though the majority of men are practically pressganged into joining Grizorg's guards.
description.ilacro: A rock protrudes from the celestial lake. The water here is pure and cool, which makes it a very popular place with the people of Arboris. La baignade est désormais interdire, les plus anciens le regrettent amèrement.
description.iplain: A vast white plain stretches for as far as the eye can see, snow is only found on the northern part of the island.
description.isnow2: A forest permanently covered in a blanket of snow stands in the middle of the uniform whiteness of the plains. A timeless calm envelops anyone who dares cross the forest...
description.imont: Considered by everyone as a sacred mountain, Everwest has a sharp peak which few have dared to try to climb. It became sacred during the reign of the former Archdorogon who used to come and meditate at the summit.
description.ihaut: A cavern which seems to have been dug into the summit of the holy mountain. There appears to be some kind of laboratory at the back of the cave. Many vials with strange colors are stored here. What kind of research was the former Archdorogon involved in up here...
description.voie: From far away, the immense observatory imposes its silhouette on the panorama that is open to all and located on Nimbao's tail. It is located on Nimbao's tail. It points its objective towards the surface, the study of stars is probably less integrated than the monitoring of the Caushemesh Mountains.
description.observ: The observatory is also a large bibliotheque that collects an impressive number of books about Dinoland's history. Unfortunately, the books are written in the language of the former Dorogons, so you cannot learn more.
description.egout: The pillar structure supporting the Archidorogon Palace incorporates a whole structure used to transport pure water into the different parts of the Dorogon city.
description.ilac: The water from the lake seems to constantly flow into the void, but the falls keep on flowing... Serait-ce la condensation des nuages qui permet à l'île d'avoir une aussi grande quantité d'eau à disposition...
description.ilac2: Behind the lakes, there is a vast expanse in the shape of a wing, there is nothing on the horizon apart from green plains bathed in sunlight. You feel the powerful wind which clears this peaceful stratch of land, you make out the tip of the wing, very few people will have seen it from the very edge though...
description.prison: The infernal prison they call the Nimbao Hilton only opens its doors once for visitors, nobody who has entered has ever come back out. Here is where they imprisoned anyone who questioned Archdorogon Grizorg's authority.
description.ville1: The Dorogon city is rich and luxurious, The residents seem really relaxed, unlike the swarms of guards that patrol the town.
description.ville2: This part of the Dorogon city offers a spectacular view of Nimbao. An enormous pillar supports the archway leading to the Archdorogon's palace.
description.sommet: The panorama is splendid, you stand at the top of the celestial island of Nimbao. In the distance, you can see the palace of the Archidorogon, bathed in light. It represents well the hegemony of the powerful dorogone civilization.
description.palais: The Palace of the Archidorogon is the jewel of the architecture of Dorogone, an ancestral technology that uses the pure water abundant in this place. The palace is huge, and sometimes labyrinthine for neophytes...
description.mport: Monster Port is true to its name. Here you'll meet all types of monsters which live on the island. The port is configured in an odd way, it almost seems as if it's split into two seperate parts.
description.mfoutp: The border between the Frutox and Vegetox kingdoms is heavily guarded. The outpost controlled by the Frutox is a strategic location from which they can spy on the Vegetox and defend the Royal Palace.
description.mfpalc: Grotox is the king of the Frutox. he is considered the most powerful Frutox among his people and he rules his kingdom with an iron fist.
description.mforst: The sacred Kaze Kami forest is renowned as being the habitat of the ancient Grotox. Ancient ruins lie at the heart of the forest which are said to contain hidden treasure...
description.mvoutp: The Vegetox outpost is hidden within a lush forest. Il est occupé par les forces spéciales Végétox qui sont formées au Camp d'Elit, et on y trouve des spécialistes en stratégie militaire.
description.mvpalc: True fortress, home of the king of Vegetox, the palace of Antraxov is obviously a well guarded place. Multiple guards patrol the area, an intruder would have a hard time trying to infiltrate this place. Le Palais est magnifique : il s'agit d'un immense arbre sculté de décorations qui vous rappellent des symboles Cuzcoussiens.
description.mcuzco: Hidden in an isolated corner of Monster Island are the ancient ruins of the capital of the Monster Empire. Today Cuzcous is no more than a pile of rocks overgrown with plants, but the buildings that are still standing show signs of a large and powerful civilisation. Many treasures are said to lie beneath these stones...
description.mcelit: Au coeur du territoire Végétox se dresse le camp d'entrainement secret des forces spéciales Végétox : le Camp d'Elit ! In this barricade place, the best Vegetox soldiers train in order to one day win the war against the Frutox. Même si celle-çi dure déjà depuis des temps mémoriaux, le moral des soldats reste intact.
description.dkbao: De l'autre coté du portail se dresse un lieu inconnu et pourtant étrangement familier. Des hurlements se font entendre au loin. Allow Dinoz to escape one death in combat
description.dkchut: A travers l'épais brouillard, on entend comme un lointain grondement, de l'eau qui s'écoule violemment. Il vaut mieux ne pas aller nager très loin, le courant est très violent...
description.dktow: Une grande Tour Noire se dresse dans ce lieu. A première vue elle semble inhabitée mais de nombreux ossements de Dinoz sont entassés à l'entrée. La grand porte sombre qui permet de rentrer dans la Tour semble entrouverte. Il vaut sûrement mieux ne pas s'aventurer plus loin pour l'instant, car entrer dans la Tour serait suicidaire !
description.dktow2: Les murs assemblés grossièrement se ressemblent tous, il en faudrait peu pour que vous vous perdiez, heureusement, il n'existe qu'un seul chemin vers le sommet.
description.dktow3: La longue ascension continue, cette Tour peu hospitalière héberge des habitants peu disposé à vous laisser tranquillement aller au sommet.
description.dktow4: Premier donjon de la tour sombre, son accès vient de se révèler, le monde sombre est toujours en constante évolution...
description.dktowa: Deuxième donjon de la tour sombre, son accès vient de se révèler, le monde sombre est toujours en constante évolution...
description.dktowb: Troisième donjon de la tour sombre, son accès vient de se révèler, le monde sombre est toujours en constante évolution...
description.dktows: Dernier donjon de la tour sombre, son accès vient de se révèler, le monde sombre est toujours en constante évolution...
description.fake: Une île déserte communément appelé l'île de la damnation, où quelques âmes en peine viennent s'échouer. Il fait particulièrement sombre par ici...
description.fake2: Une île déserte communément appelé l'île des feu-folles, ces esprits errants sèment le désespoir et la mort. Il fait particulièrement sombre par ici...
description.rechut: Grâce au morceau d'Orbe Sombre que votre dinoz possède, vous pouvez revenir à la surface. La lumière omniprésente vous aveugle quelques minutes, il vaut mieux ne pas rester trop longtemps dans le Monde Sombre.

description.winks: Winks have strange powers. They are rare Dinoz who can mutate, both temporarily and permanently. They have developed in time a veritable science, passed from generation to generation.
description.sirain: Sirains are masters of the Atlanteid Islands. They have good tactical knowledge and always keep cool head in battle. Due to these skills, they can expose their opponents' weaknesses.
description.castivore: Covered in thick hair, castivorous are peaceful herbivores. Despite their small legs they are very agile and can run quite fast. They are loyal companions to their masters and don't cause any trouble, except when they shed their thick coat of fur.
description.feross: Feross are particularly rare Dinoz. Their natural habitat is the haze of the Sticky Swamp, so it's very hard to see one of them and even harder to capture one. In spite of their nice mood, their might horn is extremely dangerous to their enemies.
description.gorilloz: Gorilloz are guardians of Dinoland's large forests, especially the Grumhel Forest. Although they are strong and ferocious, they rarely show themselves unless they must protect their territory from intruders. Gorilloz are at one with nature, and behind their stern looks they are very intelligent Dinoz.
description.hippoclamp: Hippoclamps are an elite soldier of the Atlanteid Islands. Many scientists have studied them and have concluded, that they are almost certainly the result of a successful mutation experiment on Kumps made by the Winks.
description.kabuki: Natives of the Caushemesh mountains, only a few Kakubis can be found in Dinotown Kingdom. People say that a small group of them exist, living isolated on a Southern island. In any case, they are fierce fighters !
description.mahamuti: Extinct for hundreds of years, the only way to get hold of a Mahamuti is to find a frozen one. The majority of masters who are in possession of this species are often caught off guard when it finally defrosts... They are known to destroy everything in their path...
description.moueffe: Moueffes are distant cousins of Dragons, and are proud of it. They love fire, have a tough and resistant hide, plus an outstanding sense of combat.
description.nuagoz: Life sometimes appears in odd circumstances. Life appears in strange forms; Cloudoz are a perfect example of this: made from a mix of water, air and lightning, a great deal of luck is required to give them life without them evaporating instantly. If successful they become very efficient fighters and are held in high regard by Dinoz Masters.
description.pigmou: Softpigs are small animals, renowned for their ferocity and stubborness. They only understand those more powerful than themselves. For this reason they are notoriously hard to tame, but once a Master has established his authority, they will defend him without fail.
description.planaille: Glidwings are strange flying Dinoz. Their body contains many small receptors and muscles perfectly accustomed to control every inch of their wings. This enables them to manipulate and amplify wind and electricity, which they can use as powerful weapons. Although it must be said that they are not very intelligent and are easily controlled by a Master.
description.pteroz: Pteroz are flying Dinoz who soar above Big All-Hot. They have an impressive sense of territory and it's sensible to not disturb a Pteroz Mother protecting her eggs. They are quite hard to tame but really good fighters.
description.quetzu: The Quetzu race originated on Nimbao, and since the end of the reign of Grizorg, and the isle becoming accessible to all Dinoz masters once more, it is becoming more and more common to see them around Dinoland. Their strength and agility remain unbalanced, and rarely do we find Quetzus advanced in years, when their potential is truly fulfilled.
description.rocky: Rockies are often hidden amongst the stones. They are living creatures half-animal half-mineral, their bodies are made entirely of Lodestone. This gives them the power to produce electricity at will by rubbing their bodies.
description.santaz: Santaz are from the mountains of Caushemesh. They are extremely rare and desired by Dinotown Dinoz Masters. They are difficult to tame but are very powerful and have the ability to perfectly master the Air element.
description.smog: Smog DNA was discovered by the great professor. Extracted from blood found in a leech trapped in ice, he successfully recreated the genetic code of this dinoz who was amongst the most formidable predators on the planet.
description.soufflet: Les soufflets sont des dinozs vraiment uniques, après avoir passé quelques temps sous forme de larve, c'est à l'age adulte ou ils revêtent leurs véritables formes. A flying dinoz able to compete with the best dinozs! Originally form Nimbao they are reclusive creatures, but since the troubles on the island escalated they have started to be seen more and more.
description.toufufu: Tofufus are descended from their distant cousins, the Wistitis, and are extremely difficult to catch. They are quick and smart, and it seems as though someone has taught them kung-fu...
description.triceragnon: Recently imported from the lands of Thorgnole, the Tricerithumps is extremely sought after by the discerning dino masters. Due to their aggressive nature, it can be difficult to move these dinoz from port to port without leaving a few broken planks behind !
description.wanwan: Wanwan were once considered man's best friend, before they returned to the wild. Wanwan are vivacious, able to make multi-assaults, and their long, sharp teeth are deadly. Their fur conducts electricity, enabling them to store lightning and discharge when they choose.

npc.description: You can talk to this person.

speech.begin:
Once inside the University library, you meet the famous Professor Eugene. Ce dernier est
		réputé pour son grand intérêt envers les Maîtres Dinoz. Il vous pose souvent de nombreuses questions
		mais en échange peut apprendre quelques techniques très utiles à vos Dinoz, ainsi que vous donner
		des informations très importantes sur Dinoland.
speech.talk:
Hello young Dinoz Master. So, how is everything going? So, how is everything going? Ah! Je me rappelle
		quand j'avais ton âge, j'en ai arpenté des kilomètres tout autour de Dinoland ! N'hésite pas à venir me
		poser des questions si tu veux des indices sur les grands mystères qui t'intriguent. En plus, je peux apprendre quelques techniques utiles à ton Dinoz. A condition bien sûr qu'il soit prêt, car mon enseignement n'est pas de tout repos et pourrait lui être fatal si ton Dinoz n'est pas assez entraîné.
speech.nothing: Well then, let's see. Sit your Dinoz down there... perfect. (he pulls out a small pocket light)...   Let's see your teeth. Say "Ahhhh!" ...  Mmmm ...  it seems your Dinoz is still a bit too young ... I can't teach him anything at the moment. Come back to me when your Dinoz reaches Level 5.
speech.nothing2: Let's see ...  (he examines the Dinoz...) Well, it looks like your Dinoz has really improved since the last time. However, it's not strong enough to learn the second technique... his body wouldn't support it. I think we should wait for level 6... Mmmm no, level 7 is safer.
speech.learn: So, your Dinoz wants to learn a technique? For this, your Dinoz will have to fight a monster. I will train him only if he is victorious. By the way, which technique do you want me to teach him?
speech.water: Alright. If your Dinoz wins this fight, I will teach him how to use the Buoy. With this item, your Dinoz will be able to cross short distances of water.
speech.fire:
Climbing is not easy to master, and you need some climbing material to get started. S'il arrive à gagner contre ce monstre, j'enseignerai les bases à ton Dinoz et lui fournirai le materiel
		qui devrait lui permettre de gravir le volcan du Grand Tout Chaud.
speech.water_win:
Well done, great fight! As promised, I just gave your Dinoz the Buoy. Maintenant il devrait pouvoir accéder
		aux Iles Atlantéinées au sud de Dinoland. Good luck and be careful!
speech.fire_win:
Well done, nice fight! Ton Dinoz possède maintenant le Matériel d'Escalade, et il devrait pouvoir gravir
		les pentes escarpées du volcan du Grand Tout Chaud. Les monstres là-bas sont très chaleureux, alors fais attention
		en t'y rendant !
speech.learn_water:
You come to get the buoy, right? Il te faudra d'abord combattre ce monstre avant
		que je la donne à ton Dinoz !
speech.learn_fire: Did you come to get the Climbing Gear? To get it, you'll need to fight this monster first.
speech.learn_done:
I have nothing left to teach your Dinoz. Mais ne t'inquiète pas, il y a d'autres personnes à travers l'Univers
		de Dinoland qui pourront lui faire apprendre de nombreuses techniques !
speech.question: Ah, I l-o-v-e questions ! What do you want to know, my boy?
speech.dinoville:
The Kingdom of Dinoville has been destroyed and rebuilt several times since ancient times. Today it is a prosperous and civilized place compared to the wild places that surround it. C'est pour cette raison que Dinoville est un endroit parfait pour un petiot Maître Dinoz comme toi ! N'hésite pas à bien y entraîner tes Dinoz avant de les faire s'aventurer dans d'autres endroits de
		Dinoland, car les monstres y sont bien plus dangereux qu'ici !
speech.atlante:
A long time ago, there was an island south of Dinoland. Elle avait été propulsée
		au sommet d'un pic de roche volcanique à plusieurs centaines de mètres au-dessus de l'océan suite
		à une éruption sous-marine. It was called the Jazz Island... However, little by little the ocean waves eroded the rock peak and it eventually collapsed. A gigantic tsunami engulfed a good half of Dinoland, destroying a large part of the old
human civilizations. Aujourd'hui, après quelques centaines d'années, les choses commencent enfin à se
		réorganiser peu à peu, mais une grande partie de Dinoland reste sauvage et dangereuse. Pour en revenir au sujet principal, les Iles Atlantéinées sont les fragments de l'Ile de Jazz après son
		effondrement. On dit que seul le Marais Collant n'a pas changé.
speech.gtc:
Hey kid, see that little black triangle over there to the north? C'est un immense volcan qui se nomme le
		Grand Tout Chaud. Je te conseille d'aller y faire un tour, on y mange de très bonnes merguez, grillées
		à point. Quand j'étais plus jeune, j'ai beaucoup étudié les ruines des anciennes civilisations. Savais-tu par
		exemple qu'au sommet du Grand Tout Chaud, il existait il y a de cela des millénaires la civilisation
		Ashpouk ? And then one day, boom! volcanic eruption: everything gone! Don't you find that sad? In any case, I would advise you to go digging in the ruins, you can sometimes find ancient relics there, and don't forget to taste the merguez sausages.
speech.gant:
Oh !! The Zors Glove !! It's a very rare object that your Dinoz has there! On dit que le Gant des Zors
		a un rapport avec les Chutes Mutantes et qu'il permet d'accéder à la Forêt de Grumhel, mais on ne sait pas comment s'en servir...
speech.stone: Ohhhhhhh !!! But here is something very interesting, it seems to me that it is.... uhmmuhu.... i'm not sure... (he stares at the stone)... Can you show me this Stone, that I examine it a little?
speech.stone_yes: Ooooooohhhhhh!!! Yes.... That's what I thought.... “Look! (he delicately cleans the stone)... it's an Ashpouk Totem! It has a lot of value you know... take great care of it!
speech.noquestion: Ah well, too bad, don't hesitate to come back from time to time to find out more about the world of Dinoland!

playerChoice.question: Ask a question
playerChoice.stone_no: Hey! Don't touch it! Don't touch it! Before, I would like to know something...

speech.begin: Hi there! Welcome to the matrix... Uh not in the alpha! I can help you improve your dinoz without difficulty in order to be able to test what developers are doing
speech.talk: So you can choose the element of your next level, unlock the different regions of Dinoland or simply eat a candy that will put your experience to the maximum
speech.element: I let you choose the next element of your level. You can come back to change it whenever you want.
speech.fire: There you go! See you soon
speech.lightning: And voilà! See you in a bit
speech.air: And here it is! About to start
speech.world: Which places would you like to visit?
speech.CIMETIERE: And here it is! Going afk brb
speech.GO_TO_TUNNEL: There you go friend  Bring a torch
speech.JUNGLE_SAUVAGE: And there you go ! See you soon
speech.GO_TO_STEPPES: Here you go! See you soon
speech.nothing: Sorry but you already have enough to do a few world tours. Come back to me when new worlds are added.

playerChoice.element: I want to choose the element of my next level!
playerChoice.world: I want to visit the world!

speech.begin: Lying on Mandragore's deckchair, Sofia sips a cocktail. She enjoys the sun and lets herself tan on the beach...
speech.nouvelle: Sluuuuuuuurpp.... It's not too bad, I was pretty quiet before you arrived. Go play somewhere else? Slurpp.... And don't bother my husband, I wouldn't want you giving him suspicious ideas...
speech.bien: It's better to leave her alone, if even Mandrake doesn't dare to upset her, then who would be crazy enough to do it...?
speech.troph: Slurpp.... Caushemesh fears nothing... I've tasked the girls to watch over the Dark World Breach. If there's a problem, I'll send my husband to do my job.
speech.palais: There's nothing interesting there anyway... Except perhaps an object. Humm... I don't want to go for it... Listen, I give it to you, I no longer need it anyway, now that I have the real one, hehe... Take it as a reward for finding my husband.
speech.retour: Now leave me, I have urgent business to deal with... ... Mandrachou !!!! Come and massage me... FAST !
speech.niveau: It's true that with your current level, you're not going to go very far... Well, I am able to break the limit of the maximum level of your dinoz, but beware, this decision is IRREVOCABLE! Once the limit is broken, you can evolve up to level 60!
speech.yes:
So be it ! _(Sofia gets up suddenly, concentrates her energy... and projects an intense shock on your dinoz!)_
_(Through his suffering, his organism reacts. He develops a new strength, able to overcome the hardships that will face him!)_
Well, I lifted the seal that was preventing your dinoz from evolving. This security had been fixed a long time ago to avoid an overpopulation of such powerful dinoz... _(Your dinoz has changed, it can now exceed its limits, how will it evolve? )_
speech.ether: Well, he would probably die from it... However, if he is exposed to ether for a very short time, he could develop new skills that would surely make him stronger! But be careful, you would no longer have access to the old skill tree, so you could not learn the last skills you were missing... Before exposing your dinoz to ether, be sure to have optimized its choice of skills...
speech.newskill:
So be it ! _(Sofia fait amener une cuve remplie d'ether, et y plonge votre dinoz d'un coup !)_
		_(Peu content d'être malmené, votre dinoz en ressort très vite en boudant...)_
		Voilà, ton dinoz va petit à petit comprendre la portée de cet acte quand il gagnera des niveaux supplémentaires. _(Vous regardez votre dinoz avec interrogation, sa pupille est plus verte qu'avant. Que vous réserve-t'il ?)_
speech.no: Well, if you change your mind, you can come see me again. You can also come to me with any of your dinoz that have reached level 50.
speech.no2: Well, if you change your mind, you can come see me again. You can also come to me with any of your dinoz who passed level 50.

playerChoice.niveau: Could you make my dinoz stronger?
playerChoice.yes: I am sure, my dinoz wants to evolve!
playerChoice.ether: I would like to soak my dinoz in ether!
playerChoice.newskill: I am sure of myself, my dinoz wants to learn new skills!
playerChoice.no: No thanks, my dinoz doesn't need to exceed level 50!
playerChoice.no2: No thanks, my dinoz prefers to continue learning the old skills!

speech.begin: While passing through BrutForce, you meet a woman, who just seemed to be waiting for you.
speech.talk: Here is this young Master Breeder I've heard so much about? It seems like Papy Joe says a lot of good about you, since you apply yourself at fulfilling his missions?
speech.talk2: Since you seem to be someone who can be trusted, I too would have liked to entrust you with a few missions, it's up to you to accept or not!
speech.missions: Ah sorry, this part hasn't been developed yet. Check back later.
speech.question: Who I am?!? Ah ah ah! Forgive me, my young friend, I completely forgot to introduce myself! I am.... .... ....
speech.question2: ... sorry... I'm sorry. I just remembered that I couldn't reveal who I am, because that might get you in big trouble! But since it's very rude, I'm going to tell you something interesting...
speech.double: Let's see... I assume that so far you have learned that each skill corresponds to a single element among the five possible elements? For example, Anger corresponds to the Fire element and Perception corresponds to the Water element.
speech.double2: Well... it's wrong ! There are special skills, which are associated with not just one but TWO elements! These are called double skills. One but requires prior knowledge of a skill of each of the two elements.
speech.double3: I completely understand your surprise, it's a well-kept secret. However, to be able to learn these skills, it is necessary to master Double-Skill, a secret skill that only Drag.... but I have already said too much!
speech.learn: Oh it's pretty simple, look, I just have to do 'this' and...
speech.already: What do you think? .... It seems you've already learned that! Ah ah ah!
speech.no: No... it doesn’t work... if it tingles when I do 'that' or if your Dinoz hasn't yet learned the skills allowing you to master Double-Skill, it won't work. Come back to me later to try again!
speech.dolearn: Wow! It worked! You see it was easy? Your Dinoz has now mastered Double Skill, congratulations!

speech.begin: Hi little boy, I've been waiting for you...
Pink! Pink! Pink! Pffff this coral is harder than stone, did you know that?
speech.thanks: You're nice! Come back here when your shovel breaks, I'll fix it.
speech.yes: Oh, did you know? Here, I'll lend you an old shovel so that you too can dig. It's in very bad condition so the first time it's used it will break, but it's my lucky shovel, with it you can find the greatest treasures of Dinoland! So what do you say ?
speech.nothing: So do you like my shovel? What do we say?
speech.repair: Oh it's you ? So how did you break my shovel? Don't move... here I fixed it for you!... Hep ! Aren't you forgetting something?
speech.nothing2: So do you like my shovel with the ergonomic handle? What do we say?
speech.repair2: Oh it's you ? So you did break my shovel? Don't move... here I fixed it for you!... Hep ! Aren't you forgetting something?
speech.no: Pfff, yes it's very very hard to dig, that's why you need strong guys like me to do this job.
speech.next: Yes, absolutely! Look at these muscles! I am nominated for the Corail Awards in the "Big Arms miner" category this year.
speech.next2: Yes, since I tell you! I'm going to have to work a lot more if I want to look like my idol one day...
speech.next3: So ?!!? You don't ask me who is my idol?
speech.qui:
Mais voyons ! Sylverter Stalin of course! Three times winner of the Corail Awards, in the categories
"Ultimate Muscles" and "Quotes that Kills". Il est vraiment trop coool, et il a toujours réussi a éliminer tous ses
		opposants !
speech.ok: Oui c'est le plus fort ! Alàlà, le bon vieux temps, je pourrais en parler pendant des heures... Mais bon je te laisse j'ai du boulot ! Pinck! Pinck! Pinck!

playerChoice.qui: Euh... et qui est votre idole ?

speech.begin: Hello, hello, hello, what do you want from me, Master Breeder?
speech.question: Any questions? Mmmmmmm.... How about a little mission for your Dinoz? With friends, we organize rallies all around Dinoland!
speech.nothing: Really? So perfect... Have a good trip !
speech.quest2: Come back when you have obtained the Korgons palms from of Grumhel Forest. Then I could fulfill your dearest wish.
speech.quest3: Any questions? Mmmmm... I see that you got the Korgons palms. That means you should be able to survive... over there... maybe...
speech.where: Mmmm.... To go there, you will have to gather seven Dinoz. Not necessarily yours, no, they can also be Dinoz of your Clan members. And after I send you... over there...
speech.where2:
Mmm.... It is a place... I can't tell you more. Elle te permettra de la continuer, ton aventure. Mais sâche que tu y trouvera une clé, oui,
		LA clé. Pour la porte de Sylvenoire. Finally, if you survive of course.
speech.how: How? Mmm... Listen to me. You need to gather seven Dinoz here. Yours or those of your clan members. Every Dinoz must concentrate. When you will be seven, then you will be able to go there.
speech.danger: Dangerous ? Mmm... to make it simple, I would say that you probably have little chance of surviving there... But who doesn't try anything has nothing, right?
speech.concen: Mmm... Good... i will hypnotize your Dinoz. He'll be able to concentrate better that way... Don't worry, you can stop this at any time, if you wish.
speech.quest4: Any questions? Mmmmm... You're going to need some ingredients for me to help you. Well, if I guess what question you wanted to ask me...
speech.noingr: Tsss tsss tsss.... The Coral that never breaks, the Ice that never melts, and the Branch that never fades. Looks like you're missing something, my dear.
speech.ingr: Poum poum palalam poum poum pam poum poum palalam pam! And voila, a magnificent Anti Sedh Potion for you...
speech.potion: Mmmm... goodbye my friend, come back to see me sometime!
speech.ok: Et voila ton dinoz se concentre ! Lorsque vous serez suffisament, vous vous retrouverez dans un autre monde.
speech.bye: Until next time and have fun!

playerChoice.question: I have a question for you...
playerChoice.concen: I want to concentrate my Dinoz!
playerChoice.potion: So you are an Ancient Monkey!!!

speech.begin: Hi ! You spoke to Mr Bao? He's really aaaaaawesome, isn't he???
speech.ok: Hey, it's true!! He's so cool! I even crossed the Forest of Grumhel on purpose so that he would tell me lots of great stories! You know what, he knocked out a demon gorilloz once! Yes ! Et puis il était entouré de plein d'animaux méchants ! And you know what? et ben il les a tous battus !
speech.wah: Yes ! Et M. Bao a bien voulu m'apprendre quelques trucs ! Il a dit que je suis très doué pour mon âge ! C'est bien, hein ? Wait look... je vais envoûter un truc, tu veux que je te montre ?
speech.yes: .............. Well, I'm done ! You want it ? Here... It's a Bao Charm! Alors prends-en soin, hein ! Ca devrait aider ton Dinoz pendant quelques combats. Quand tout le fluide spitruel sera épuisé, tu pourras revenir me voir pour que je le recharge !
speech.spirit: Huh... yes that's it ! Spitri... péritel... spriti... ! Ho ils sont trop compliqués vos mots technologiques !
speech.thanks: Hooo tu t'en vas déja... Tu reviendras, hein ? A bientôt alors !
speech.nothing: Ah... mais ton Dinoz a déjà un Charme Bao ! Regarde, y'a encore de l'energie... tu vois ? Quand il ne marchera plus, je pourrai te le recharger.
speech.no: Ah bon ? Bon, ben tant pis pour toi alors... *boude*.

playerChoice.thanks: Bon, je dois partir... merci beaucoup pour le Charme Bao !

speech.begin: Vous entrez dans les forges de Fosselave. la chaleur qui règne ici n'a rien à envier à l'intérieur du cratère du Grand Tout Chaud. Ici rien ne se crée, tout se transforme, à grand coup de marteau !  100 pièces d'or pour réparer une pelle, c'est donné  non ?
speech.pelle: Et une pelle dans la gueule ca te tente ?
speech.repair: Et voilà, ta pelle est réparée mon ptit gars ! That'll be 100 gold coins. You're nice, don't forget to pay at checkout.
speech.repair2: There you go, your shovel is repaired my little guy! That'll be 100 gold coins. You're nice, don't forget to pay at checkout.
speech.thanks: Come back if you still need our services!
speech.no: Come back with your pockets full little guy, you're wasting our time!

playerChoice.repair2: Can you repair my super shovel ?

speech.begin: Hi breeder... Don't make a sound, you mustn't disturb the Korgons!
speech.korgons: Yes, it's the little creatures that have settled here. Don't look them in the eye... Don't look them in the eye... And if one of them gets too close, you can always try to give him a piece of wood to nibble on
speech.why: They might take that for a challenge! And here, I let you imagine what would happen if all the Korgons in the camp got it into their heads that you were an enemy... The last to have tried were served at dinner the same evening.
speech.wood: They love it ! This is also the reason why they settled in the Jungle of Grumhel. Fascinating isn't it? But unfortunately for us, they are able to eat everything and anything, including careless travellers.
speech.tame: A long time ago, I think the Korgons were domesticated. Probably long before the fall of Jazz Island... But today, they are totally back to there wild state! No way to approach them without risking losing an arm. A few breeders also tried, but no one got better from them than a big bite.
speech.interest: Right! I'm glad to see you like these adorable Korgons so much! If that interests you, you could do a few little tasks for me at the Camp?
speech.service: Perfect! This is what I need...

playerChoice.why: We should not look at them?

speech.begin: Ola ola ola! They are very greasy, my merguez! ....... How? What idea to come and sell merguez sausages in such a dismal place? But these Ruins are gorgeous!! Je suis certain qu'un jour ce sont des millions de touristes qui viendront les visiter !
speech.ah: Oui, tout à fait ! C'est un peu comme l'acre-aux-pôles : mon cousin y a fait une fortune en vendant des porte-clés en forme de temple. Alors ici, c'est décidé, je serai le premier ! Même si je dois attendre plusieurs années que le commerce se lance, pas question de laisser passer cette opportunité en or !
speech.ok: Tiens, ton Dinoz m'a l'air bien maigre... Prends ces merguez ! C'est gratuit à condition que tu ailles parler des Superbes Ruines Ashpouk à tes amis. Ok, tu n'oublieras pas alors ?
speech.thanks: De rien, de rien, c'est bon pour le business !

speech.begin: B'jour jeune av'turier, bienv'nue à Fosselave... la capitale du Grand T'chaud... Hésite pô à admirer nos super sculptures en basalte. Y'a aussi les bains de magma, là bas... Ca va te relaxer, tu verras c'est coooool... Si t'as faim, t'peux goûter not' spécialité : les merguez de Gobelin... Ca te ravigore, youuuhouuu, tu peux pas imaginer...
speech.vener: Uhmm... ? Le V'nérable ?... Quel bourrin celui là... hier il a failli me bouffer... tout ça parce qu'il me trouve trop agité, et que ça l'empêche de dormir... Tu veux vraiment y aller ? Boah... Tourne à droite aux Forges, et c'est tout droit. c'est toi qui voit...
speech.souvenir: Des souv'nirs ?... Bah... j'ai bien ma pile de feuilles d'incantations en retard là, mais je sais pas si ça t'interesse... J'peux te filer un autographe aussi, signé de mon vrai nom, Baston Labaf... non ? Ok tant pis... Sinon y'a des trucs de combats aux Forges... des équipements de combat, et tout ça là... Y'aura p'têt un truc cool pour toi.
speech.charm: Ah ouais, c'est vrai... y parait que j'dois t'aider... Here, a Fire Charm... ça aidera bien ton dinoz dans ses prochains combats.
speech.boost: Bouge pas, j'vais t'enchanter de la magie des Shamans... Hey, hey! ZZZZzzzzzz... ... C'est bon, tu peux y'aller, t'es un balaise maintenant.
speech.nothing: Hey, essaye pas d'me rouler, ton dinoz a déjà un charme... Come see me later.
speech.force: Strong? the big dorogon Come here?... yeah a bit... It is the leading cause of death among tourists, just ahead of heart attacks caused by our merguez sausages... Ha la la, qué p'tites natures ces touristes...
speech.more: Uhmm.... If your Dinoz agrees to fulfill a few missions for me, I'll entrust him with my Strategy Guide. It's very useful...

playerChoice.souvenir: Can we buy souvenirs in the area?
playerChoice.charm: I have been told of a charm...
playerChoice.merci: Thanks, I'll take your advice into account!

speech.begin: Un immense arbre vous fait face... De toute évidence, il est particulièrement agé et semble empreint d'une grande  sagesse. Lentement, très lentement, ses feuilles s'abaissent dans votre direction et bruissent doucement.
speech.shake: Tandis que vous le secouez (si tant est qu'on puisse secouer un arbre si grand), vous percevez un étrange  et long grognement venant de l'intérieur même de l'écorce ! Quelque chose tombe brusquement du feuillage  sur votre tête : poc !
speech.item: C'est une sorte de grosse noisette enveloppée dans un parchemin. Et à plus grande votre surprise, vous  constatez qu'il y a quelque chose d'écrit sur ce parchemin !

speech.begin: Un individu bizarre maladroitement caché entre les arbres vous fixe  avec un regard inquiétant... Il brandit une lanterne dans votre direction.
speech.hi: L'homme a l'air inquiet et continue à vous toiser sans rien dire...
speech.approch: A peine faites-vous un pas dans sa direction que l'homme bondit,  terrorisé, et se jette dans un fourré un peu plus loin ! Un instant plus tard,  sa tête émerge du feuillage et vous fixe à nouveau avec inquiétude...
speech.run: Vous prenez vos jambes à votre cou !
speech.ignore: Vous tournez la tête ailleurs pour essayer de l'ignorer. Mais tandis que vous jetez  à nouveau un coup d'oeil dans sa direction, vous constatez avec surprise qu'il se  dresse face à vous droit comme un piquet !! Vous ne pouvez vous empêcher de pousser  un cri de surprise ! Il vous colle alors sa lanterne sous le nez et vous renifle  bruyamment...
speech.intro: Peur ? Peur de quoi ? Les ombres ou les voix ? Vous avez peur aussi ? On a tous peur !  Moi je les ai vus !
speech.leave: Vous reculez lentement puis vous tournez les talons sans prendre la peine de jeter  un regard derrière vous...
speech.seenWhat: Gorgoth !! Celui qu'on appelle l'innommable mangeur de têtes de la noirceur abyssale !!
speech.show: Il terrorise tout ce qui vit dans la Jungle de Grumhel !! Sachant que la Jungle terrorise déjà  tout le monde. Tenez regardez, il est juste là (il pointe du doigt la végétation épaisse et  noire) !
speech.fight_win: Alors que vous recherchez du regard l'homme bizarre, vous constatez sans grande surprise qu'il  a disparu... La bonne nouvelle c'est qu'il a laissé sa lanterne en prenant ses jambes à  son cou. Vous pourrez utiliser cette lanterne pour ne plus perdre votre chemin dans les  endroits obscurs.

playerChoice.fight: Attaquer Gorgoth (l'innommable mangeur de têtes de la noirceur abyssale) !

speech.begin: L'accès au Dôme Soulaflotte n'est possible qu'en utilisant un Rascaphandre.
speech.rasca: Un Rascaphandre est un gros poisson avec des arêtes creuses. Il est capable de stocker une grande quantité d'oxygène et ainsi d'emmener son maître jusqu'aux profondeurs où se situe le Dôme Soulaflotte, sans que celui-ci ne meure asphyxié.
speech.where: Les Rascaphandres sont nombreux dans les eaux des alentours, il faut juste savoir les appeler.
speech.call: (soupir)... En fait, il faut un objet particulier : un appeau à Rascaphandre. C'est une petite flûte que l'on plonge dans l'eau et qui imite les ondes du grand requin noir maléfique des abysses pestilentielles, le repas préféré des Rascaphandres. Ils se précipitent alors et vous pouvez en utiliser un pour vous rendre au Dôme.
speech.appeau: Oui. L'appeau à Rascaphandre est fabriqué avec des arêtes de vieux Rascaphandre. Mais plus ils sont vieux, plus ils ont mauvais caractère et ils deviennent alors très dangereux...
speech.old: J'ai un ami pêcheur au Port de Prêche, si vous n'avez pas peur du danger, je peux lui demander de vous emmener chasser le vieux Rascaphandre géant... Allez le voir de ma part, il s'appelle Jovébozé.
speech.thanks: Je vous souhaite un bon séjour sur les Iles Atlantéinées.

playerChoice.where: Vous savez où je peux en trouver un ?
playerChoice.call: Super !... Heu... vous avez leur numéro ?

speech.begin: Ol'a el chti ga ! Té vi laté du viou Rasca ?
speech.trad: Personne ici ne semble comprendre ce que dit Jovébozé. D'après les informations que vous avez recueillies, il s'agirait d'un dialecte local de Prêcheurs, voire d'un dialecte spécifique à Jovébozé...
speech.sry: Sité popré ven pa, sino mot'dan lobatou, k ?
speech.go: Jovébozé vous emmène en mer dans un coin que les bateaux semblent éviter... En vous approchant, vous voyez ce qui semble être un énorme Rascaphandre à quelques dizaines de mètres de la barque. Si vous continuez dans cette direction et si le Garde Atlante disait vrai, vous serez surement attaqué... Il faut faire vite !!!
speech.attack_win: Bien entendu, Jovébozé n'a rien compris a vos instructions... Après votre fier combat, il vous ramène au Port de Prêche. Il n'a pas décroché un mot depuis l'attaque du Rascaphandre mais il vous observe du coin de l'oeil, l'air satisfait. Au moment de vous séparer, il vous serre la main vivement, en guise d'encouragement pour la suite de vos aventures. Il vous confie un Appeau a Rascaphandre qu'il a sculpté...

speech.begin: Au centre du Dôme se trouve la résidence de l'Archisage. Il s'agit d'un titre honorifique donné à un Archimage devenu trop vieux pour pouvoir utiliser ses pouvoirs magiques. Il n'en reste pas moins un personnage doué d'une très grande connaissance, même si ses propos peuvent parfois sembler confus.
speech.enigm: Bonjour bonjour bonjour ! Que viens-tu chercher ici ? Tu cherches quelque chose ? Puis-je t'aider ?
speech.next: Ah! Ne dis rien ! Je sais, je suis sûr, certain, tout à fait ! Tu cherches un GRAND TRESOR !
speech.tresor: Alors écoute, voilà je vais te dire. Ecoute-moi. Oui. Je vais te raconter. Si tu me rapportes. Oui tout cela. Tu veux savoir quoi ? et surtout quoi n'est pas !
speech.quoi: Alors écoute. Mon premier est collant, mon deuxième basaltique, mon troisième est de l'eau pure. Il te faudra un outil, ça oui. Un outil pour trouver tout cela. Reviens me voir et je t'apprendrai le trésor, mais attention au danger ! F-O-E !
speech.show_win: Oh ! Bravo ! Bravo ! Merci pour tout ça, et surtout bravo ! Voilà, c'est fait, ton Dinoz a un GRAND TRESOR !

speech.begin: Les Chutes Mutantes sont l'un des Grands Lieux de méditation des moines Zenzen. C'est pour cette raison qu'on en trouve souvent dans le coin. En s'installant sur de grandes feuilles de nénuphars, ils essaient de méditer le plus longtemps... sans pour autant se faire entraîner par le courant ! De nombreux moines s'étant un peu assoupis se sont offert une descente des chutes : en tout cas, personne ne les a jamais revus.
speech.get: ...Ah ? Euh... oui... m'apporter... une feuille... de nénuphar...
speech.give: ...merci.... je vais pouvoir.... enfin... méditer sur... les Chutes !!!! Je t'offre cette Perle en récompense... elle rejoindra ta Collection d'objets !
speech.act: Youhouhhh !!! C'est génial ! Regarde... je flotte !
speech.gant: Oooh !!! C'est un Gant des Zors que tu as là ? GENIAL !!!
speech.why: Je vais t'expliquer... Le Gant des Zors a le pouvoir d'annuler le courant des Chutes, autour de toi. Ainsi, à l'aide d'une feuille de nénuphar, on peut contourner les Chutes et accéder à la Forêt de Grumhel qui se trouve au-delà.
speech.super: Bon, si tu me promets de me laisser utiliser ton Gant de temps en temps, je te prête les feuilles de nénuphar qui te permettront de passer les Chutes... marché conclu ?
speech.ok: Voilà, tu as les feuilles de nénuphar... Et fait attention, la Forêt au delà est très dangereuse ! Tu vas désormais pouvoir passer les Chutes, bon courage pour la suite de ton aventure !

playerChoice.where: Et où je vais trouver cela ?

speech.begin: Bonjour, heu... je suis Bémol, le padamoine de Maître Hydargol. Et heu... je dois lui amener ces feuilles de nénuphar. Le problème c'est que, heu... je viens de me rendre compte que j'avais le mal de mer... pourtant je dois me rendre sur les Iles Altantéinées ! Qu'est-ce que je vais bien pouvoir faire ???
speech.help: C'est vrai, vous acceptez de m'aider ?? Merci beaucoup !
speech.get: Vous avez l'air digne de confiance. Tenez, je vous confie ces feuilles de nénuphar, et que la Sainte Force soit avec vous !

playerChoice.help: Je dois justement y aller aussi. Je peux lui app...

speech.begin: Un homme en tenue de safari se tient debout à l'Orée de la Jungle de Grumhel. Il a l'air d'attendre quelque chose...
speech.welcome: La Jungle de Grumhel ! Cet espace sauvage et encore vierge, protégé de toute agression extérieure par sa faune dangereuse, reste aujourd'hui une terre de mystère et de contraste qui séduit chaque année de nombreux explorateurs. Séquence frisson. "A la découverte d'un Monde Sauvage", c'est aujourd'hui, en ma compagnie !
speech.who: Nicolas Mulot, journaliste pour le magazine Ouïaïa et amoureux de Dinoland !
speech.role: Pas pour un journaliste de l'extrême comme moi. Il y a tout ce que je recherche ici: un monde inexploré, une faune et une flore riches, tant de choses fabuleuses à découvrir à chaque pas !
speech.myst: Je l'ignore encore... Mais... Mais je suis convaincu qu'il y a des choses fabuleuses qui se cachent dans cette jungle ! Il faut juste oser y entrer... Séquence peur bleue.
speech.flora: Ces arbres millénaires cachent aux yeux des hommes leurs plus beaux atours ! Mais pour qui sait regarder, c'est un ravissement pour les sens. Senteurs exotiques, fleurs multicolores, végétation luxuriante... La Jungle de Grumhel, "Une Aventure au pays de Mère Nature", séquence Exploration !
speech.whynot: Disons qu'il existe quelques plantes peu engageantes aussi... Comme la "Toxicae Virulente Noire" ou la "Sauvagine Géante Dévoreuse de Foie"...
speech.fauna: Entre les roncivores, les korgons et les fauve-souris, la Jungle de Grumhel recèle de dangers qui dépassent l'imagination ! A la fois Terre hostile et Terre Promise, cette partie de Dinoland ne se laissera pas si facilement apprivoiser...
speech.fear: Euh, comment dire... C'est... Disons un contretemps technique. Il serait plus prudent, je pense, de planifier d'abord une mission de reconnaissance. Avant de plonger corps et âme dans l'aventure, cela va de soi !
speech.explore: Ca serait une excellente idée ! Il faut dire qu'il n'y a pas beaucoup de passage par ici... Un petit coup de main serait le bienvenu... Séquence action.
speech.other: Oserez-vous plonger dans les mystères insondables de la Jungle de Grumhel ?
speech.sick: Alors que Nicolas Mulot se retourne pour vous répondre, vous constatez avec horreur qu'il a le visage tout boursouflé et couvert de verrues et autres boutons !
speech.problem: Euh... Bien le bonVour. Ne le prenez pas trop mal, mais Ve crois que les plantes que vous m'avez amené étaient comme dirait... eux toxViques... Ve crois bien que mon allervie aux plantes a pris une Fertaine ampleur... Vous pourriez peut être m'aider à Drouver un remède ? ...
speech.sickstatus: Alors, vous avez trouvé un rebède ?
speech.better: Le remède que vous m'avez amené a été très efficace !

playerChoice.role: Ca n'est pas un peu dangereux pour un journaliste ici ?
playerChoice.myst: Quels genres de mystères existent ici ?
playerChoice.flora: Il y a de belles plantes par ici ?
playerChoice.whynot: Pourquoi n'entrez vous pas dans la jungle alors ?
playerChoice.fauna: Parlez moi des animaux de la Jungle...
playerChoice.fear: Ah... Vous voulez dire que vous n'osez pas voir ça par vous-même ?
playerChoice.explore: Je peux vous aider si vous le voulez ?
playerChoice.problem: Ouh la ! Qu'est-ce qui vous arrive ?
playerChoice.better: Vous avez l'air d'aller bien mieux...

speech.go: Ouf ! Il vaut mieux faire attention en rencontrant des étrangers...
speech.talk: Uh ?!??? Quoi ?? Vous pouvez me VOIR ?!? ..... Grrrrr....
speech.yes: Uhm... bien... je vois... on m'avait pourtant certifié que cette cape rendait invisible ! Est-ce que tu peux regarder l'indicateur dans le dos, il y a marqué quelque chose ?
speech.read: Quoi ?!? "L'EAU BATTE-RIZ" ? Uhm... le vendeur parlait effectivement de recharger quelque chose... il va donc falloir que j'utilise du... riz !?! Mais où vais-je pouvoir trouver cela ?!?
speech.talk2: Vite ! J'ai BESOIN de ce Riz !

playerChoice.go: Ce personnage a l'air dangereux... s'éloigner !

speech.begin: Ma cape est à nouveau en panne... je commence à en avoir un peu marre...
speech.qual2: Au lieu de dire des conneries, tu ferrais mieux d'essayer de remplir ta mission...
speech.qual: QUOI ?!? Comment oses-tu parler ainsi de la grande technologie Caushemeshenne ! Sais-tu simplement combien d'années recherches il a fallu à nos scientifiques pour maîtriser l'Ether ?!?
speech.caush: Oui ! Tout à fait, la grande civilisation des Montagnes de Caushemesh, bien au delà des Steppes Magnétiques. Nous sommes bien plus développés que les barbares de Dinoville...
speech.ether: Aprés des centaines d'années de recherche, les Caushemeshens ont maîtrisés la puissance de l'Ether, un savant mélange des éléments Air et Vide. Celà nous donne une puissance technologique hors du commun, et les ingénieurs de Caushemesh sont les meilleurs de tout Dinoland !
speech.next: Vos Dinoz sont bien faibles comparés à ceux de Caushemesh, ils ne font pas le poids ahahahah ah ! Entraîne bien tes Dinoz, jeune maître, car un jour viendra où tu devras affronter des dangers bien plus grands !
speech.more: Mais j'en ai déjà trop dit... Pour te convaincre de la technologie de Caushemesh, que dirais-tu d'une petite mission ?

speech.begin: Pour ton information, les Dinoz Sombres que tu as rencontré jusqu'à présent n'étaient que des débutants que nous venons faire entraîner dans cette partie de Dinoland... La puissance des Dinoz de Caushemesh va bien au delà, et même votre Vénérable ne ferait pas le poids contre nos meilleurs maîtres Dinoz !
speech.next: Enfin bon, je tiens ma promesse. Voici une récompense pour te convaincre de la supériorité de la  technologie de Caushemesh. Je n'en ai qu'un exemplaire, alors fais-en bon usage... Il s'agit d'un Bracelet en Tik, que tu pourras équiper sur le Dinoz de ton choix...

speech.begin: Un récent tremblement de terre semble avoir créé une fissure dans la paroi. Un air glacé s'en échappe et vous apercevez un homme bizarre qui inspecte les alentours.
speech.talk: Pfiiooooouuu !! Tu as vu cette fissure ? elle s'ouvre sur une gigantesque caverne dans laquelle règne un froid glacial ! Attention ! Si ton Dinoz y rentre, il sera entièrement congelé !
speech.gla: Tu vois !! Ça pèle dans le coin hein.... D'après mes études thermodynamiques, les courants de magma chaud du Grand Tout Chaud absorbent la chaleur des roches supraconductrices et créent donc dans le sous-sol un refroidissement par convection. Un véritable Frigo naturel en fait !
speech.ok: N'est-ce pas !? Je suis un grand explorateur des cavernes et autres souterrains étranges, c'est mon métier, je suis spélélélologue ! J'ai obtenu mon diplôme en Spélélologie à l'Université de Dinoville, option naturalgorithmie !
speech.ok2: N'est-ce pas !? J'ai couru ici dés que j'ai entendu parler du tremblement de terre, et du coup j'ai été le premier à découvrir cette grotte ! Je lui ai déjà trouvé un nom : La Grotte du Zéro Relatif ! Ça te plaît ?
speech.ok3: N'est-ce pas !? Bon, tu m'es sympatique et je vais donc te donner une ASTUCE ! Si tu mets ton Dinoz dans la Grotte du Zéro Relatif, il sera congelé...
speech.congel: Oui ! Con-ge-lé ! Mais la température est tellement basse qu'il ne mourra pas ! Tu ne pourras plus te servir de ce Dinoz, mais du coup il ne comptera plus dans ta LIMITE de nombre de Dinoz, ce qui te permettra d'obtenir PLUS de Dinoz ! Il faudra par contre faire attention aux effets secondaires...
speech.congel2: Oui, à partir du moment où ton Dinoz est congelé, il ne compte plus dans ta LIMITE, mais tu ne peux le décongeler que si tu es à nouveau en dessous de la LIMITE, cela veut dire qu'il faudra congeler un autre Dinoz pour le remplacer... Et puis, ton Dinoz mettra de toute façon un jour entier à décongeler, il faudra donc un peu de patience... Tu as compris ?
speech.thanks: De rien ! N'hésite pas a faire appel à moi si un jour tu as besoin de mon aide pour explorer un souterrain mystérieux !
speech.bye: Tchaw ! Et surtout fais attention à ne pas t'approcher de cette fissure !

speech.begin: Un étrange Dinoz à l'allure menaçante est apparu sur votre chemin. Ses yeux rouges vous fixent intensément, il a l'air très féroce !
speech.fight_win: Vous avez vaincu un Ptéroz ! Vous obtenez le Trophée des ptéroz qui vous permettra désormais d'acheter ce Dinoz dans la Boutique des Dinoz !
speech.leave: Ouf ! Un pas de plus et ce Dinoz vous attaquait !

speech.begin: Un étrange Dinoz est apparu sur votre chemin, puis s'enfuit... Que désirez-vous faire ?
speech.fight_win: Vous avez vaincu un Dinoz rare : un Hippoclamp ! Vous obtenez le Trophée des Hippoclamps qui vous permettra désormais d'acheter ce Dinoz dans la Boutique des Dinoz !
speech.leave: On dirait qu'il ne revient pas... Mais de quelle espèce pouvait-il bien s'agir ?

speech.begin: Une étrange pierre se dresse au milieu du chemin, Son emplacement ne semble pas très naturel... Que désirez vous faire ?
speech.fight_win: Oooops !! La pierre en question était un Rocky, un Dinoz moitié animal moitié minéral assez rare dans le Royaume de Dinoville... En l'ayant vaincu, vous obtenez le Trophée des Rockys, qui vous permettra désormais d'obtenir des Rockys dans la Boutique des Dinoz. Bravo !
speech.touch: C'est étrange... la pierre semble chaude au toucher. Il n'y a rien d'autre de spécial... Peut-être vaut-il mieux ne pas insister...
speech.leave: Vous avez raison, après-tout ce n'est qu'un simple caillou....

speech.begin: GWWWWWWWWAAAAAAARGGGGGGGHHHHHH !!!! Qui oooose venir me dérangerrr pendannt ma siiiessteee ?????
speech.bye: Vous avez raison, il y a des fois dans la vie ou il vaut mieux prendre son courage à deux mains et effectuer une retraite stratégique en vitesse, et si possible sans se faire voir...
speech.moi: UUUHMMMM ?? Et que me veux-tu au juste ??? Tu as intérêt à avoir une bonne raison, sinon je vais faire GRILLER ton Dinoz pour mon PETIT DEJEUNER !!!
speech.korgon: UHHMM ??? un KORGON, dis-tu ??? Où ça, Où ça ? Tu m'as donné faim !!
speech.next1: OOhhh ! Quel DOOMMMAAGGE !! Ca doit être ENERVANT alors ! Je comprends je comprends ! Dans ma jeunesse, j'ai souvent laissé échapper quelques petits déjeuners comme ça. Maintenant je les GRILLE directement, comme ça ils n'ont pas le temps de s'enfuir !
speech.fight_win: GROOOOAAARRH !!! Tu as GAGNE pour cette  FOIS ! MAIS nous nous REVERRONS !
speech.moi2: UHMMMM ? Oui, bon, je me rappelle de ton Dinoz. Qu'est-ce que tu me veux encore ?
speech.question: Alors, mangeur de Korgon, est-ce que je peux GRILLER quelque chose pour toi ? Ou autre chose ? N'en demande pas trop, car sinon je te DECOUPE en petits morceaux croustillants qui seront parfaits pour mon PETIT DEJEUNER !!!
speech.force: UHHMM ??? Plus FORT tu dis ? BON... alors suis mon conseil : va voir le SHAMAN de Fosselave, il t'aidera à GRILLER tes ennemis !
speech.fight2: UHMM... J'ai une petite FAIM... que dirais-tu de remettre cela à plus tard ???

dinoz.help: Welcome to Dinoz! Here, **daily**, you can discover the different Dinoz options available for adoption. Choose the one that suits you best.

item.help: Click on these items to take a closer look...
item.advice_1: Want to take another turn? Try Madam Irma's potion: you'll love it!
item.title: Merchant:

flying.name: Dinoland Flying Shop
flying.description: The Dinoland Flying Shop is always accessible. Just whistle (loudly - the shop can be a little hard of hearing) and the store will arrive, allowing you to purchase a variety of basic items. As you explore Dinoland, you'll come across other Shops in Dinoland with more interesting items.

forge.name: Forges Shop
forge.description: The Forges are where items made from the fire of the Big All-Hot are also sold. You can find lots of useful items for battle there.

magic.name: Magic Shop
magic.description: In the heart of a small alley in Dinoville, adventurers sometimes get lost and then find the Magic Shop... The extremely rare and powerful items it sells cannot be purchased with vulgar gold pieces. On the other hand, these objects are bewitched: once equipped on a Dinoz, they cannot be removed for several days!

cursed.name: Cursed Shop
cursed.description: The Cursed Shop sells rare items that cannot be found elsewhere. As it is said that whoever enters it is cursed for life, only those who are already cursed dare to venture there...

fruity.name: Fruit Shop
fruity.description: "If you leave gold in the bucket hanging from the old tree, a fruit will fall!"! »

razad.name: At Razad
razad.description: Razad is an old nomad who fled the western steppes, which had become too dangerous for his business. Today, its store is much more modest than before, but at least it is secured at the Rocky's Outpost.

souk.name: Souk "Lightning Sales"
souk.description: The souk is located a little away from the Magnetite Pylons, offering a very nice view of the electric arcs that regularly form in this region. Unfortunately, the shop is not beyond the reach of these arcs, which poses some obvious problems...

neerhel.name: Provider of Toutemba
neerhel.description: Le Pourvoyeur's little shop is hidden deep in the canyons of Toutemba in a well-protected cove. Normal when you know the dangers of the region...

barbarian.name: Barbarian barter
barbarian.description: “Price not negotiable. You not touch goods. NOT TOUCH I SAY! If you touch, me CRUSH you!”

secret.name: Secret Store
secret.description: "Team-W's secret store contains all the Magnetic Steppes items in one place, and above all at a very reasonable price! »

elit.name: Elit Shop
elit.description: Vous trouverez dans cette Boutique divers objets que les forces spéciales Végétox utilisent souvent au cours de leurs dangereuses missions.

chens.name: Boutique de Chen
chens.description: Chen met à votre disposition des compétences consommables, elles sont tellement puissantes qu'elles se détruisent après utilisation. Elles sont à utiliser avec parcimonie.

merchant.name: Travelling Merchant
merchant.description: Le Marchand Ambulant se promène dans tout Dinoland et achète les Ingrédients des Maîtres Dinoz : il offre beaucoup d'or !
merchant.dimanche: Le Marchand Ambulant a pris son jour de congé, il faudra patienter jusqu'à demain pour pouvoir vendre de nouveau vos ingrédients. Bien sûr, le Marchand Ambulant se sera déplacé à un lieu différent, il faudra donc le trouver avant de pouvoir vendre vos ingrédients.
