faq.intro: Vous pouvez trouver ici toutes les réponses à vos questions sur le jeu. Essayez toutefois de ne pas trop utiliser cette section, car de nombreux secrets sont plus amusants si vous les découvrez par vous-même en cherchant un peu.

faq1.question: Why can't Grandpa Joe's last two missions be unlocked?
faq1.answer: The 'Giants' mission will be unlocked when your Dino reaches level 11 and the 'Achievement of the Month' when he reaches level 18.

faq2.question: Where's Mrs Ducraft's dog?
faq2.answer: Le Chien de Mme Ducraft se trouve au Port de Prêche, accessible depuis la Fontaine de Jouvence. La fontaine de Jouvence est accessible depuis Dinoville, Forcebrut, ou Chez Papy Joe.

faq3.question: How to get more than 18 Dinoz?
faq3.answer: The U Leader skill :bois: allows you to have 3 more Dinoz on your account. && The same goes for :air: Messiah on the new 50+ skills tree. && && U (unique) skills only work once per account. && After that, it's possible to have many more by freezing some of your Dinoz.

faq4.question: How to obtain the Fountain Pearl?
faq4.answer: You will need the Buoy. && From the Frish Port, access the Waikiki Islands (Atlantean Islands), then proceed to the Mutant Falls (accessible from the Soulaflotte Dome, Bao Bob's Place, and from the Sticky Swamp). && && Talk to Master Hydargol, and follow his instructions. If you successfully complete the mission he gives you, you will obtain the Fountain Pearl.

faq5.question: How to remove a skill from a Dinoz?
faq5.answer: Learned skills cannot be removed, but you can disable certain ones using the 130-lesson Strategy Guide you will obtain by completing "The Archelionscarer" - the second mission of the Soft Shaman. && && As a general rule, avoid choosing attacks (A skills) in the minor elements of your Dinoz. && For example, Water Cannon is not recommended for a pigmou.

faq6.question: How to obtain the Lantern?
faq6.answer: Firstly, you must have the Zors Glove to access the Grumhel forest through the Atlantean Islands. && && Go to the Haunted Hills and talk to the Strange Man. Ignore him and fight a monster. && The Lantern allows you to go to the Deep Gorges and complete the Hieroglyphs mission of the Soft Shaman.

faq7.question: How to obtain the Zors Glove? How do I get to the Gruhmel Forest?
faq7.answer: Firstly, you'll need the Buoy, Climbing Gear, Shovel, and Diver's Mask. && With the Shovel, dig at the Basalt Slopes (Hot Mounts), the Sticky Marsh (Atlantean Islands), and the Fountain of Youth (Dinotown). You should obtain the statuses 'Marsh Mud', 'Granite Shard', and 'Pure Water'. && && Next, go to the Underwater Dome and talk to the Archisage, then give him your collected items. After battling the Wood Elemental, you will obtain the Zors Glove. Now head to the Mutant Falls. && && I'm unsure if you already need to have the Fountain Pearl, but it's preferable. Talk to Master Hydargol at the Mutant Falls and agree to lend him the Zors Glove. You will receive a Lily Pad Leaf. Now, you can access the Grumhel forest from the Mutant Falls.

faq8.question: Where is the market of the Atlantean Islands where I need to exchange a banana for a coat rack (second mission of Bao Bob, 'The barter of the Atlantean Islands')?
faq8.answer: This mission is done in stages. You will need to go to the Coral Mines, then to the Waikiki Islands, then to the Mutant Falls, then to the Sticky Swamp, back to the Coral Mines, and finally to Mr. Bao Bob's. && && In each of these places, you must talk to a character and make the exchange they propose.

faq9.question: What to choose in the game of Heads or Tails against Yakuzi?
faq9.answer: Regardless of the choice, the first bet will inevitably be lost while the second will inevitably be won.

faq10.question: How does the Fountain Pearl work?
faq10.answer: Any Dinoz at the Fountain of Youth at midnight will gain 5 HP per day upon your daily login. The effect is not cumulative.

faq11.question: Where can I find the dictionary I asked for in Soft Shaman's first mission, 'The trial'?
faq11.answer: The dictionary is at the University.

faq12.question: Can I have my Dinoz fight together?
faq12.answer: You cannot have them fight against each other, but you can have them fight alongside each other. To group your Dinoz, they must be in the same location and each have an available action. && && Select the action 'Follow': your Dinoz are now in a team. You can group up to three Dinoz; the limit can increase to five if the leading Dinoz of the group has learned the skills :wood: Sympathy and Charisma.

faq13.question: I've completed Grandpa Joe's missions, how can I get more?
faq13.answer: At the Atlantean Islands, Mr. Bao Bob (At Mr. Bao Bob's) will offer you a new list of missions. At the Hot Mounts, it's the Soft Shaman (Lavapit) who needs your services.

faq14.question: How to access the Magnetic Steppes?
faq14.answer: You, or the members of your clan if you have one, must gather 7 Dinoz at Bao Bob's (equipped with the Korgon's Fins, it's mandatory). && && Once the 7 Dinoz are gathered, you will have access to a portal that will take you to a world where, after a little journey and defeating a big guardian, you will obtain a key. && && This key, the one to the Sylvenoire Gate, will grant you access to the Magnetic Steppes... Accessible from the Grumhel forest. && && Advice: primarily intended for high-level Dinoz, around level 30 and above... Dinoz with a Major Water Element are at a disadvantage.

faq15.question: Where can you find Yakuzi?
faq15.answer: Yakuzi appears at random in the Frish Port.

faq16.question: What are the conditions for creating/joining a clan?
faq16.answer: To create a clan: you must have at least 20,000:gold: and 15 points. && && To join a clan: you must have 1,000:gold: and a minimum of 4 points.

faq17.question: Where to use the shovel for digging?
faq17.answer: Once you've obtained the Shovel, and knowing that after each use you'll need to return it for repair at the Coral Mines, there are 4 places to dig: && && 1.At the Sticky Swamp. && && 2.At the Fountain of Youth. && && 3.At the Basalt Slopes. && && 4.At the Ashpouk Ruins.

faq18.question: Where to find the missing package?
faq18.answer: Talk to the guy who lost the package at the Grand Hot Forge. To do this, go down to the Basalt Slopes. You need to kill 4 Goblins. && && Then, go back up to the Tunnel under the Branch. 6 Goblins to kill. && && Return to validate the mission at Lavapit.

faq19.question: How to access the Underwater Dome?
faq19.answer: With the Scorpscuba Caller from the Mutant Falls. && && To obtain the mask, you will need the Buoy and a fairly strong Dinoz. Go to the Atlantean Islands from the Preach Port, and head to the Mutant Falls. Talk to the Atlantean Guard, he will tell you about a fisherman friend at the Preach Port. So, return to the Frish Port and talk to Jovébozé. && && He will take you to fight a Diver, and if you manage to kill it, he will give you a Scorpscuba Caller.

faq20.question: Where to find the Magic Stars?
faq20.answer: Follow the instructions given by the Strange Being you will randomly encounter at the Fountain of Youth. && && Additional hints: && && First star: The Capital is none other than Dinotown. You will need a new action to fight the Megawolf. && Second star: The Enthusiastic Fatty is the Sausage Vendor found at the Ashpouk Ruins. && Third star: The riddle speaks for itself. && Fourth star: the call... the Shovel... && Fifth star: Capsicum is a vegetable more commonly known as a pepper. && Sixth star: The God-Man is Bao Bob. && Seventh star: Saru means 'monkey'. Be careful, you must already be in the Wild Jungle before letting your Dinoz die there.

faq21.question: How do you obtain a relic?
faq21.answer: To obtain a relic, you need to dig at the Ashpouk Ruins and then go to the university to authenticate the relic. && && To obtain it, you need firstly: the Buoy, Climbing Gear, and Shovel. Minimum levels for the Buoy and Climbing Gear: 5 and 6. && && The relic allows access to the BrutForce tournament.

faq22.question: How to access the Grumhel forest from the Deep Gorges or how to access the second part of the Grumhel forest?
faq22.answer: You will need the Zors Glove, a Lily Pad Leaf, and the Buoy. Go to the Mutant Falls, and move to the Grumhel forest (Location 'Bypassing the Mutant Falls'). From there, head to the Haunted Hills. Talk to the Strange Man and ignore him. He will then talk to you about a dreadful monster and ask to fight it. You will then enter a battle with a Mischievous Korgon. If you manage to defeat it (which is highly possible), the Strange Man will flee, leaving you his lantern. Now, leave the Grumhel Forest, leave the Atlantean Islands, leave DinoLand, and go to the Tunnel under the Branch. From there, access the Deep Gorges. From the Deep Gorges, access the Korgon Camp. You are now at the Korgon camp, in the second part of the Grumhel forest. To link the two parts, complete the missions of Dian Korgsey and obtain the Korgon Fins. Now, you have the ability to move from the Korgon Camp to the Jumin River, and vice versa.

faq23.question: Comment obtenir la Pelle (Creuser) ?
faq23.answer: First you need the Buoy. From the Frish Port, go to the Atlantean Islands, then move on to the Coral Mines. Talk to the Coral Miner and say yes. && He'll give you the shovel, but every time you dig it will break, and you'll have to come back to him to get it fixed.

faq24.question: Dark Dinoz and Hippoclamp, Pteroz and Rocky trophies
faq24.answer: The Dark Hippoclamp can be found on Waikiki Island, accessible from the Frish Port via the Buoy. Defeating it will earn you the Seahorse Trophy. And you need to be at least level 8 to see it. && && The Dark Pteroz can be found on the Basalt Slopes, accessible from the Climbing Hills with the Climbing Equipment. You'll get the Pteroz Trophy by beating it. && && The Rocky is in BrutForce. It isn't visible until level 13 and is difficult to defeat until level 15, but it will earn you the Rocky Trophy. && && Trophies are epic items that can be seen on your account. They allow you to buy the dinoz corresponding to the Trophy in the Enclosure: hippoclamp if you have the Hippoclamp Trophy, etc.

faq25.question: How do you freeze a dinoz?
faq25.answer: Go to Deep Gorges and talk to the spelunker. He'll offer to freeze your dinoz. && This will allow you to raise an extra dinoz. && && Of course, you'll need the lantern to access the deep gorges.

faq26.question: How do I get a Kabuki?
faq26.answer: To obtain this precious dinoz, you'll need the Kabuki aura, which you can get by completing Yakuzi's quest! && && To begin with, you'll need to meet Yakuzi at the Frish Port (a random encounter), and accept his two bets. && He will then disappear, and you can meet him again, first at the Forges, then at Deep Gorges. && During the latter encounter, you will obtain a parchment, which you will have to have translated at the University by a professor. && The professor will tell you that you need to give him a number of ingredients to advance your quest. && Once you've been given these ingredients, and after waiting a few days, you'll have to go to the Coral Mines (you may have to wait a little while for a tab to appear, like for a mission stage). && To complete this quest, you'll have to chase your attacker to Totem Island, which isn't accessible beforehand. && && You'll also get a Kabuki Egg, and the Kabuki Aura, which will allow you to visit this place as often as you like.

faq27.question: How do I sell my Dinoz?
faq27.answer: To be able to sell your Dinoz, you must already own two (you can't stay without a Dinoz). Then go to the Market Place, click on Breeders' Market and then on Sell. && WARNING: this operation is irreversible.

faq28.question: Anguilloz in vinegar
faq28.answer: Finding the right place... that's what's so difficult and keeps us going round in circles, isn't it? && && Here's a little help: && && -> You have to go to Dinotown.

faq29.question: How do I retrieve my Dinoz´s life?
faq29.answer: There are 4 ways: && && Buying and using the health objects available in the store. && Using the rest option. && When the Dinoz is at the Fountain of Youth with the Pearl of Youth at midnight. && By equipping the Tik Bracelet on one of your Dinoz and and waiting until Midnight.

faq30.question: Where do I restart when my Dinoz is Dead?
faq30.answer: If you do not use an Angel Potion, You will restart at DinoTown with 1 health point and you will lose half of your Experience. && && If you use an Angel Potion, You restart where you are with 1 health point.
